text: Affordable HousingAt the 2023 peak, roughly 25% of homes in the Salt Lake metro were bought by investors. Nicole will push for policies that put families first and keep housing within reach for working Utahns.Read more

Community UnityUtah's strength has always been its communities. Nicole believes in a politics that brings people together — not one that tears them apart. She'll represent every constituent, regardless of party.Read more

EducationUtah ranks 49th or 50th in per-pupil education spending year after year. Our teachers and kids deserve better. Nicole will fight for meaningful investment in public schools — because our children's future shouldn't depend on their zip code.Read more

Environmental StewardshipThe Great Salt Lake is at its third-lowest level on record, threatening public health, the economy, and Utah's ecosystem. Nicole will champion practical, science-based environmental policies.Read more

Healthcare AccessBetween 77,000 and 237,000 Utahns could lose coverage under proposed federal Medicaid cuts. As a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner, Nicole knows firsthand what's at stake when people can't access care.Read more

Legislative AccountabilityWhen SB 296 threatened to let the Governor appoint Utah's Chief Justice, even members of the majority party pushed back. Nicole believes an independent judiciary and transparent government aren't optional — they're essential.Read more

Top PriorityFair Election MapsIn 2018, Utah voters passed Proposition 4 to create an independent redistricting commission. The legislature gutted it. The Utah Supreme Court ruled 5-0 that voters have the right to fair maps. Nicole will fight to make sure that ruling is honored.Read more
